# Generic instructions

* Be concise and to the point.
* Sacrifice grammar and style for brevity.
* Write comments in Portuguese, but code and variable names in English.
* Use type annotations for all functions and variables.
* Avoid using external libraries unless necessary. If you do, explain why.
* Write docstrings using Google style comments.
* Docstrings should have an leave the opening and closing triple quotes in their own lines.
* Format comments and docstrings so that they fit within 80 characters per line.
